notes: Read SKILL.md in full (single-file skill). The skill covers least-privilege IAM policies, role creation, cross-account assume-role, GitHub Actions OIDC federation, permission boundaries, Access Analyzer/credential-report auditing, Terraform IAM resources and sample SCPs.

Medium: following it has the agent run state-changing `aws iam`/`aws accessanalyzer` commands with the user's configured AWS credentials (create-role, put-role-policy, attach-role-policy, create-open-id-connect-provider, create-policy, create-analyzer) and write credential-report.csv locally (SKILL.md:292). Still acceptable because the commands are illustrative reference examples with placeholder account IDs and names, nothing deletes resources or weakens security (the policies tighten access: deny unencrypted uploads, deny IAM escalation, require IMDSv2), and they act only in the user's own account.

Users should review before applying: the sample SCP and boundary deny all actions outside us-east-1/us-west-2 (SKILL.md:255-266, 410-422), which would break workloads elsewhere if attached unchanged. Exported AWS keys at SKILL.md:154-156 are obvious placeholders (ASIAXXX/xxx). Related Skills (SKILL.md:443-447) link to sibling skills ../terraform-aws/, ../aws-ec2/, ../aws-lambda/, ../aws-ecs-fargate/, ../../../compliance/governance/access-review/ as optional reading only.
